sentences.text: Michelle LaVaughn Robinson Obama -LRB- born January 17 , 1964 -RRB- is an American lawyer and writer who was First Lady of the United States from 2009 to 2017 .	First Lady of the United States	First Lady of the United States

She is married to the 44th President of the United States , Barack Obama , and is the first African-American First Lady .	Barack Obama	Barack Obama	44th	List of Presidents of the United States	first African-American	List of African-American firsts

Raised on the South Side of Chicago , Illinois , Obama is a graduate of Princeton University and Harvard Law School , and spent her early legal career working at the law firm Sidley Austin , where she met her husband .	Chicago	Chicago	Illinois	Illinois	Princeton University	Princeton University	South Side	South Side, Chicago	Harvard Law School	Harvard Law School	Sidley Austin	Sidley Austin

She subsequently worked as the Associate Dean of Student Services at the University of Chicago and the Vice President for Community and External Affairs of the University of Chicago Medical Center .	Chicago	Chicago	University of Chicago	University of Chicago	University of Chicago Medical Center	University of Chicago Medical Center
Barack and Michelle married in 1992 and have two daughters .

Obama campaigned for her husband 's presidential bid throughout 2007 and 2008 , delivering a keynote address at the 2008 Democratic National Convention .	Democratic	Democratic Party (United States)	2008 Democratic National Convention	2008 Democratic National Convention

She returned to speak at the 2012 Democratic National Convention , and again during the 2016 Democratic National Convention in Philadelphia , where she delivered a speech in support of the Democratic Presidential nominee , and fellow First Lady , Hillary Clinton .	Democratic	Democratic Party (United States)	2012 Democratic National Convention	2012 Democratic National Convention	2016 Democratic National Convention	2016 Democratic National Convention	Philadelphia	Philadelphia	Hillary Clinton	Hillary Clinton
As First Lady , Obama became a fashion icon , a role model for women , and an advocate for poverty awareness , nutrition , physical activity , and healthy eating .
